testScenario: Lab 1 - Scenario 5: Worker Failure Followed by Correction and Recovery
description: External job worker throws simulated unhandled exception due to temporary database downtime or unparsed payload. An incident is created in Operate, resolved, and retried successfully.

operateIncidentInspection.errorMessage: Worker validate-loan-applicant threw RuntimeException: Simulated worker database connectivity failure

incidentResolution.rootCause: Database connection pool timeout simulated on worker node.
incidentResolution.correctiveAction: Toggle simulateWorkerFailure=false in payload / variable editor in Operate or restart worker service.
incidentResolution.retryAction: Trigger Retry Incident in Camunda 8 Operate.
incidentResolution.expectedPostRecoveryState: Worker completes validation, token progresses to Credit Assessment and completes approval.
